Pakistan Studies as a subject is continuously promoting the status of the state, keeping in sight such scope and importance of Pakistan Studies, AWKUM established this department in 2016. Since then we are trying our best to instil awareness among the students about the vision of Pakistan as given by our leaders during the freedom movement and after the emergence of Pakistan as a state. Every rational citizen of Pakistan must have base and background knowledge about the true and sincere freedom movement and ideology of Pakistan. As this great movement was raised and supported by a religious slogan, so the citizens must work for the development of their country in the light of its virtuous history. For these purposes, the department is educating its students and is enhancing the spirit of an Enthusiastic and real patriotic citizenship which was envisioned by its founding fathers. We pray Allah Sincerely to add all our efforts effectively in the development of great Pakistan.

Chairman
Department of Pakistan Studies
AWKUM
